name: Minter.io
description: Minter.io helps users inspect connected social media reports, discover available analytics metrics, and query report data from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Threads through Claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add Minter.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Minter.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://minter.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Minter.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minter.io provides these MCP tools: accounts_discovery, data_query, and field_discovery.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Minter.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Minter.io in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Minter.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Minter.io is developed by Minter.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
